description: Adds a small selection of ships and fighters. Includes balance changes to the Petard bomber and Wasp(P) wing size. Fixes sprite issues and folder capitalization for Linux compatibility.
descriptionHtml: Adds a small selection of ships and fighters. Includes balance changes to the Petard bomber and Wasp(P) wing size. Fixes sprite issues and folder capitalization for Linux compatibility.
discordPostHtml:
A small mod with a couple of ships and fighters, forged in a volcano and folded a thousand times like a ragged towel.

Balance feedback appreciated!

Download link:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PeiPi3OE4QWimBE84HykcyrN1F9OWnir/view?usp=sharing

Changelog:

Changes in 1.2.1:
Changed Petard:
- speed from 130 to 120
- refit from 20 to 28
- OP cost from 15 to 18
- Greatly reduced the firerate of its launcher.
The Petard was intended to be a slow priority target firing slow priority missiles. The firerate used to be high enough to form a barrage of what were essentially slow homing hammers. Now the bomber can be intercepted early (if you actually launch the required firepower at it to take it down) and interrupt the launch. Was also a bit too cheap for what it did.

- Buffed Wasp(P) wing size from 3 to 4.
The wing did not have really enough impact in my eyes. Perhaps an extra bomber will help?

- Removed floaters from the Supervisor sprite
AAAAA

- Fixed some folder capitalisation that caused linux to throw tantrums

TODO: 

- Fix Anomaly Curtain AI to only fire when projectiles are headed towards the ship
- Rebalance Stormsprite because its kinda meh right now
- Prrrobably look into making the Angst a bit more interesting

Credits to Nia's Dakkaholics and Trailer Moments for the first banner image.
